title: CE North America Recalls Fan Heaters Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Bed Bath & Beyond
summary: The fan heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 28,000 in the United States (in addition, about 260 were sold in Canada).

title: Dollar General Recalls Construction Truck Toy Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Dollar General
summary: The toy truck's remote control can short circuit, causing it to overheat and posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 27,000.

title: Head USA Recalls Ski and Snowboard Helmets Due to Head Injury Hazard
summary: The helmets do not comply with the impact requirements of safety standards for helmets, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 260 in the United States (in addition, 180 were sold in Canada).

title: KHS America Recalls Children's Musical Instrument Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The pink metal note bar on the glockenspiel may contain excessive levels of lead in the paint, violating the federal lead paint standard. If the paint is scraped off and ingested lead can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 150.

title: Wedgwood Decorative Baby Rattles Recalled by WWRD Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The ball bearings inside each side of the decorative rattle can be released, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 670 in the U.S. (in addition 24 were sold in Canada).

title: Eastwood Recalls Multi-Function Power Packs Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The power packs' lithium ion batteries can burst during charging, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 500.

title: Lutron Electronics Recalls Roller Shades Due to Impact Hazard
summary: The window shades can become dislodged from their brackets and fall, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 30,000 (in addition about 5,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Microsoft Recalls AC Power Cords for Surface Pro Devices Due to Fire, Shock Hazards
summary: The power cords can overheat, posing fire or shock hazards. Units: About 2.25 million (in addition, about 190,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Royal Appliance Recalls Dirt Devil Pet Vacuums Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The vacuum's electric cord plug prong can detach and remain in the electrical outlet when the vacuum is unplugged. The detached prong can pose an electrical shock hazard if it remains connected with the electrical outlet. Units: About 149,000 in the United States (in addition, about 9,700 in Canada)

title: Scubapro Recalls Dive Computers
summary: A short circuit allows the dive computer's screen to freeze or display inaccurate information, posing a risk of serious injury to a diver underwater, including decompression sickness. Units: About 1,500.

title: Apple Recalls Travel Adapter Kits and Plugs Due to Risk of Electric Shock
summary: The two-prong wall plug adapters for Australia/New Zealand/Argentina, Brazil, Continental Europe and Korea can break and expose the metal portion of the adapter, posing an electric shock risk. Units: About 814,000 (In addition, about 81,000 were sold in Canada).

title: BYA Sports Recalls Skyline Backyard Zipline Kits Due to Fall Hazard
summary: A crimp in the zipline can fail allowing the cable to pull free or become slack while in use, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 5,700 (in addition, 990 units were sold in Canada).

title: ENVE Recalls Bicycle Forks Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The left leg of the bicycle fork can crack above the disc brake mount, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 600.

title: J. Crew Recalls Girls' Coats Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The buttons on the front of the coat can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 16,400 (in addition, 63 units were sold in Canada).

title: Raynor Recalls Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair seat can detach, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 1,200.

title: Snowboard Boots with Boa Secondary Reels Recalled by Boa Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The secondary reel can become stuck in the open position, causing the fit at the forefoot of the boot or tongue to loosen and posing a fall hazard. Units: About 33,000 (in addition, about 4,500 in Canada).

title: Goodman Company Expands Recall of Air Conditioning and Heating Units Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The power cords on the air conditioning and heating units can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards. Units: About 5,300 (In addition, about 233,500 PTAC units were recalledin August 2014.).

title: Michaels Recalls Artificial Poinsettias Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: Mold can be present on the stems and bushes, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in consumers with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 425,000 (in addition, 6,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Michaels Recalls Holiday Paper Boxes Due to Risk of Mold Exposure
summary: Mold can be present on the boxes, posing a risk of respiratory or other infections in consumers with compromised immune systems, damaged lungs or an allergy to mold. Units: About 288,000 (in addition, 1,170 were sold in Canada).

title: Crescent Point Energy Recalls To Inspect Propane Gas Due to Fire and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled propane does not have sufficient levels of odorant to help alert consumers of a gas leak. Failure to detect leaking gas can present fire, explosion and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 118,000,000 gallons (U.S.) (additional units sold in Canada).

title: Nuna Baby Essentials Recalls High Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The arm bar can bend or detach during use, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 5,600 in the U.S. (in addition, 350 were sold in Canada).

title: Arctic Cat Recalls Snowmobiles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The brakes can fail, posing a risk of injury or death to the operator. Units: About 1,600.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Swivel Dining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs can break at the base, posing fall hazard to the user. Units: About 800 (in addition, 4 were sold in Canada).

title: Classic Characters Recalls Infant Booties Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store
summary: The pompoms at the tip of the toe can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 4,000 pairs.

title: IKEA Recalls Ceiling Lamps Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic retaining clips that secure the glass shades to the lamp housings can break and allow the glass shades to fall, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 840,000 (in addition, about 427,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Viessmann Recalls Gas Boilers Due to Fire and Carbon Monoxide Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The boiler can overheat and emit flue gases into the venting system and carbon monoxide can leak throughout the residence, posing a fire and carbon monoxide hazard to consumers. Units: About 165 in the United States (in addition, about 141 were sold in Canada).

title: England's Stove Works Recalls to Repair Freestanding Pellet Stoves Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Smoke can build up inside the firebox due to ash accumulation and the glass in the door can break, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,300.
